set.description:
Revision7 spec/scene layout repair only. Author only two disjoint native slots: wall-exhaust-route source[0,240,116,112] and wall-exhaust-support source[116,267,8,45] in256x352 atlas. Preserve ten locked native crops byte-for-byte, including archived partition-lower; omit that legacy path from scene. Render=(X,Y-Z+32). World centreline (168,143,43)->(168,143,37)->(248,143,37)->(248,72,37)->(264,72,37)->(264,72,41); render (168,132)->(168,138)->(248,138)->(248,67)->(264,67)->(264,63); local (24,100)->(24,106)->(104,106)->(104,35)->(120,35)->(120,31). OD4 half-open bands, horizontal band render136..140. No collars outside these pipe bands except inside native hood/wall socket, never at a protected rectangle. Lowest pipe Z35 clears adult30 by5px. Bracket top render[260,59,268,63], four actual surface rows local27..30; south face63..104/contact100..104 on existing W at ground264,72/Z41. Native hood underside socket render168,132 is retained and the new connection turns downward to the low overhead route; inspect actual joint at1x/3x. No new floor occupancy. Protect teacher cauldron[144,64,160,80], table[96,80,160,94], face/hands, board/windows, upper-right student bodies[178,111,191,129]/[194,111,207,129]/[210,111,223,129], all upper student action crops[172,97,228,129], upper hands/tools[160,84,224,112], upper table south face[160,112,224,128], lower heads/hands/tools[160,144,228,177]. Never erase pipe alpha with actors. No fixed whole-module scene layer. Three disjoint source rectangles exhaustVisibility.assemblyPieces partition the new slot exactly: wall/north connection depth72..96, right rise depth96..143, hood/low horizontal depth143. The upper bench/props/actors at worldY96 precede the depth143 pieces; lower bench/props/actors at worldY144 follow them. Use actual segment Z37/43 and worldY; never reverse depth to hide occlusion. Keep original19materials and actors, all anchors/actions, full48x64 bays,4row piers,23x14 ground, offset32, door3states and south stairs. Low contrast aged brass,42colour theme palette, narrow highlights; no added floor noise. Open actual candidate, locked crop comparisons and actual local1x/3x samples. Check continuity at all three source-piece seams, hood and wall/socket, protected alpha and installed support4row top/side/contact. If source pixels exceed route bands or cover protection, FAIL with coordinate fixes; missing local sample requires sample generation before judgement. Write {PACK}/verdict.json PASS/FAIL and mandatory slotResults for BOTH unlocked slots. Pipe topMin0/top_y=null and no claimed furniture top. Support top_rows4/top_y[0,3], side_elevation=false only if actual top plus south face are visible, contact_y44 and actual PNG/file/coordinate evidence. Complete room four states1x/3x, all19requirements, hierarchy, passages and original comparisons are mandatory after collection in art-context-review, not a prerequisite for an unmade parallel component. Preserve previous FAIL verdicts and originals; no user selection or engine integration approval implied.
Production requirement is low-vault: ten preserved structural slots plus wall-support and pipe replace the complete prior low-vault atlas. The prior failed student-safe-exhaust collection was mistakenly attributed to hood-lighting. Record native PNG and receipt under low-vault and additionally hood-lighting ONLY for its actual exhaust-route contribution, retaining the complete original hood-lighting PNG/receipt. This addition retires only the prior failed mixed atlas, never the original hoods/lights. Do not invent PASS or claim complete hood-lighting replacement. Native slots partition the actual object: pipe116x112 topMin0, separate support8x45 topMin4; do not weaken check_candidate/production gates or widen the support. Support source y267 corresponds render59 and local top0..3; actual contact at local44 corresponds render103. Native route envelope128x112 still assembled in the three pipe segments plus the independently wall-depth support. Transparent remainder x124..127 and x116..123 outside y267..311 must remain transparent.
